# PR #1565: Patch: a job ran over 7 minutes

Closes #1556

## What changed and why

CI run 39642226573 had `db (deploy rehearsal)` at 7m 50s, over the 7-minute alert. This PR makes the half of the fix that lives outside `.github/` (which the bot may not touch): `crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh` can now run as four small jobs instead of one long one, with stub-docker unit tests proving the new paths.

- `REHEARSAL_STAGE=image` builds the whole image exactly as the full rehearsal does today (`-t` the image, the same cache flags, `--load` under buildx) and, when `REHEARSAL_SAVE_IMAGE` is set, `docker save`s it to that path, prints `the image stage is built`, and exits with no database, no container, no boot.
- `REHEARSAL_LOAD_IMAGE` runs `docker load -i` instead of building, then continues with database setup and boots unchanged (the tarball carries the image tag, so `start_server` is untouched).
- `REHEARSAL_BOOT` selects boots: `migrate` runs boot 1 then boot 2 on one database, `stale` runs only the stale-`CATALOG_VERSION` boot on a fresh database, empty/`all` runs all three in today's order on one database, so `super.yml` and local runs (no new env) behave exactly as before.
- Four bad combinations fail before any docker call: unknown `BOOT`; `STAGE` with `BOOT`; `SAVE_IMAGE` with `LOAD_IMAGE`; either image flag with `STAGE=deps`/`crates`.
- `apps/web/src/net/deploy-rehearsal.test.ts` gains three `it(...)` cases (bad `BOOT`; `STAGE`+`BOOT` and `SAVE`+`LOAD`; `STAGE=image` emits one `-t`/`--load` build plus one `save`, no `run`, exit 0) and a header note that boot sequencing is proven by CI's rehearsal jobs and the daily full run, not unit tests. The old `STAGE` error-message assertion was updated to the new `deps, crates or image` wording.

## How it was tested

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/deploy-rehearsal.test.ts`: 8/8 pass (5 existing + 3 new).
- `sh -n crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh`: clean.
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean. No Rust, catalog, or spec change, so those checks are unaffected.
- `git status` shows only the two intended files; the WASM build the web test runs first left no `apps/web/src/wire` diff.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- `BOOT=all` counts as set for the `STAGE`+`BOOT` rejection (simplest reading of "STAGE together with BOOT"); rejected treating `all` as unset there.
- `LOAD_IMAGE` with `STAGE=image` is rejected too (building and skipping the build at once is nonsense); the plan named only `deps`/`crates`. Rejected silently letting one win.
- `SAVE_IMAGE` with no `STAGE` saves after the full build and continues to the boots; rejected failing or silently ignoring it.
- From the plan, kept: image-as-artifact over per-shard rebuilds (three thin-LTO links leave no headroom); two boot shards over three (the nothing-to-migrate check needs the first boot's database); stale boot stays per-PR as the proof of stale-`CATALOG_VERSION` behavior.

## Look twice

- The boot `case` wraps add no output, but confirm the default path's stdout is unchanged by eye.
- The `--load` condition is now `[ -z "$STAGE" ] || [ "$STAGE" = "image" ]`; `deps`/`crates` still get no `--load` and no `-t`.
- Boot sequencing itself is not unit-tested here (needs real Postgres); the new CI jobs verify it on first run, with the daily full rehearsal as backstop.

## For a person: the `.github/workflows/ci.yml` edit (bot may not touch it)

In `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, after the existing `db-deploy-deps` job (line 1025), add `db-deploy-crates` (same skeleton; `needs: [changes, db-deploy-deps]`; env `REHEARSAL_STAGE: "crates"`, same `REHEARSAL_CACHE_FROM`, `REHEARSAL_CACHE_TO: type=gha,mode=max,scope=deploy-rehearsal`; run `sh crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh`). Replace the old `db-deploy` job (line 1043) with `db-deploy-image` (`needs: [changes, db-deploy-crates]`; env `REHEARSAL_STAGE: "image"`, same `REHEARSAL_CACHE_FROM`, `REHEARSAL_CACHE_TO` only on main/staging with the old job's exact expression, `REHEARSAL_SAVE_IMAGE: ${{ runner.temp }}/deploy-image.tgz`; then upload artifact `deploy-image` from that path, `retention-days: 1`) and a `db-deploy-boot` matrix job (`name: db (deploy ${{ matrix.boot }})`; `needs: [changes, db-deploy-image]`; `matrix.boot: [migrate, stale]`; download artifact `deploy-image`; pre-pull `postgres:16`; env `REHEARSAL_LOAD_IMAGE: ${{ runner.temp }}/deploy-image.tgz`, `REHEARSAL_BOOT: ${{ matrix.boot }}`). Rewire the `db` summary (line 1061): `needs` becomes `[changes, db-suite, db-deploy-deps, db-deploy-crates, db-deploy-image, db-deploy-boot]` in place of `db-deploy-deps, db-deploy`, and the script extends its env/result checks (`CRATES`, `IMAGE`, `BOOT`) alongside the existing `test "$DEPS" = success` / `test "$DEPLOY" = success` lines (lines 1081-1083), replacing the single `DEPLOY` check with one per new job.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.

Notes the reviewer left (not blocking):

- `crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh:353`: BOOT dispatch (migrate/stale/all case splits) has no unit test; it is proven only by the future split CI run and the daily full rehearsal.
- `crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh:379`: The stale shard runs on a fresh database while the original stale boot ran on the migrated database, so it proves stamping but not preservation of a pre-existing stamp.
- `task`: Sub-5-minute headroom for each new shard is unproven until a person applies the ci.yml matrix and CI runs; the image job still does the full thin-LTO build plus save/upload/download/load overhead.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 18.0 min | green | approve |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 5s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 383s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 1s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 2s |

</details>
